question.html:
Consider the following statements about electrons:

I. Electron diffraction through crystals provides evidence for the wave nature of matter.

II. Electron diffraction through crystals is observed when the de Broglie wavelength of the electrons is greater than the separation of the atoms in the crystal. 

III. The de Broglie wavelength of an electron is inversely proportional to the speed of the electron. 

Which of these statements are correct?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
